caption:
Every blessing you have tonight came from one place

Allah reminds us that whatever blessing we have is from Him, and when hardship touches us, it is to Him alone that we cry out. Count three blessings before you sleep, and thank the One who gave them.

Surah An-Nahl 16:53

Name three blessings you almost forgot to thank Allah for
